items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Like Lester was going to be like Coleman Hawkins, remember?

ctx.x: different baby, we can’t use you, sorry.” I mean those guys weren’t even recognized at first because they were too different. “You’re too different man, can’t you just fall in?” “Well if I fall in then I’m going to be just like everybody else.”
Yeah. Like Lester was going to be like Coleman Hawkins, remember?

“Ivy Divy baby, I ain’t playing that. I’m playing me. You know? So it’s hard to be different you know. And you know I’m not saying it’s hard to be different because I’m different, I don’t think I am. I am not innovating. I’m following in the steps of some people that I dug. I’m not even trying to be a torch bearer or any of that other stuff. I just happen to like the music that I sing. I like that music. I don’t know if — I mean you never know, you never know until it happens, but if somebody came up to me and…
